Exit Load 0.1% Lock In No Lock-in TurnOver 77.96% Risk Very High Risk About SBI Flexicap Fund SBI Flexicap Fund Direct Growth is an equity fund. This fund was started on 1 January, 2013. The fund is managed by Anup Upadhyay. The fund could potentially beat inflation in the long-run. Key Parameters SBI Flexicap Fund has ₹22897 Cr worth of assets under management (AUM) as on Aug 2026 and is more than category average. The fund has an expense ratio 1.3. Returns SBI Flexicap Fund has given a CAGR return of 14.81% since inception. Over the last 1, 3 and 5 years the fund has given a CAGR return of 3.91%, 10.23% and 9.69% respectively. Holdings SBI Flexicap Fund has allocated its funds majorly in Cash Equivalent, Financial Services, Consumer Cyclical, Industrial, Health, Government, Basic Materials, Tech, Communication, Energy, Consumer Defensive, Real Estate, Utilities.

Its top holdings are ICICI Bank Ltd, HDFC Bank Ltd, Larsen & Toubro Ltd, Bajaj Auto Ltd, JSW Infrastructure Ltd Taxation As it is a flexi cap mutual fund the taxation is as follows:For short term (less than a year) capital gains will be taxed at 20% For long term (more than 1 year) capital gains will be taxed at 12.5% without indexation benefit Dividends will always be taxed at slab rate. Long term gains upto Rs 1 lakh are exempt capital gains tax. Investment objective of SBI Flexicap Fund To provide investors with opportunities for longterm growth in capital along with the liquidity of an open-ended scheme through an active management of investments in a diversified basket of equity stocks spanning the entire market capitalization spectrum and in debt and money market instruments. Minimum Investment and lockin period

Minimum Investment and lockin period Minimum investment for lump sum payment is INR 1000.00 and for SIP is INR 500.00. SBI Flexicap Fund has no lock in period.
